arxiv-2105-00926.title: Multiple quantum scar states and emergent slow-thermalization in the flat-band system
arxiv-2105-00926.creator: Yoshihito Kuno, Tomonari Mizoguchi, Yasuhiro Hatsugai
arxiv-2105-00926.description: Abstract Quantum many-body scars (QMBS) appear in a flat-band model with interactions on the saw-tooth lattice. The flat-band model includes a compact support localized eigenstates, called compact localized state (CLS). Some characteristic many-body states can be constructed from the CLSs at a low-filling on the flat-band. These many-body states are degenerate.

arxiv-2111-08639.title: Anomalous chiral transport with vorticity and torsion: Cancellation of two mixed gravitational anomaly currents in rotating chiral p + i ​ p p+ip Weyl condensates
arxiv-2111-08639.creator: J. Nissinen, G.E. Volovik
arxiv-2111-08639.description: Abstract Relativistic gravitational anomalies lead to anomalous transport coefficients that can be activated at finite temperature in hydrodynamic and condensed matter systems with gapless, linearly dispersing fermions. One is the chiral vortical effect (CVE), an anomalous chiral current along the system’s rotation axis, expressed in terms of a gravimagnetic field in a rotating frame and a mixed gravitational anomaly.

arxiv-2201-06394.title: Correlation Cube Attack Revisited
arxiv-2201-06394.creator: Jianhua Wang (🖂), Lu Qin (🖂), Baofeng Wu (🖂)
arxiv-2201-06394.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jianhua Wang (🖂), Lu Qin (🖂), Baofeng Wu (🖂). In this paper, we improve the cube attack by exploiting low-degree factors of the superpoly w.r.t. certain ”special” index set of cube ( ISoC ). This can be viewed as a special case of the correlation cube attack proposed at Eurocrypt 2018, but under our framework more beneficial equations on the key variables can be obtained in the key-recovery phase.

arxiv-2207-10184.title: On Leclerc’s conjectural cluster structures for open Richardson varieties
arxiv-2207-10184.creator: Peigen Cao, Bernhard Keller
arxiv-2207-10184.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Peigen Cao, Bernhard Keller. In 2016, Leclerc constructed conjectural cluster structures on open Richardson varieties using representations of preprojective algebras. A variant with more explicit seeds was obtained by Ménard in his thesis. We show that Ménard’s seeds do yield upper cluster algebra structures on open Richardson varieties and discuss the problems that remain in order to prove that they are cluster algebra structures. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2209-12922.title: A dynamical model for Brownian molecular motors driven by inelastic electron tunneling
arxiv-2209-12922.creator: Federico D. Ribetto, Sebastián E. Deghi, Hernán L. Calvo, Raúl A. Bustos-Marún
arxiv-2209-12922.description: Abstract In recent years, several artificial molecular motors driven and controlled by electric currents have been proposed. Similar to Brownian machines, these systems work by turning random inelastic tunneling events into a directional rotation of the molecule. Despite their importance as the ultimate component of future molecular machines, their modeling has not been sufficiently studied.

arxiv-2312-04344.title: Enhancing Medical Task Performance in GPT-4V: A Comprehensive Study on Prompt Engineering Strategies
arxiv-2312-04344.creator: Pengcheng Chen, Ziyan Huang, Zhongying Deng, Tianbin Li, Yanzhou Su, Haoyu Wang, Jin Ye, Yu Qiao, Junjun He
arxiv-2312-04344.description: Abstract OpenAI’s latest large vision-language model (LVLM), GPT-4V(ision), has piqued considerable interest for its potential in medical applications. Despite its promise, recent studies and internal reviews highlight its underperformance in specialized medical tasks. This paper explores the boundary of GPT-4V’s capabilities in medicine, particularly in processing complex imaging data from endoscopies, CT scans, and MRIs etc.

arxiv-2408-15681.title: Towards a Unified Benchmark and Framework for Deep Learning-Based Prediction of Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Chemical Shifts
arxiv-2408-15681.creator: Fanjie Xu, Wentao Guo, Feng Wang, Lin Yao, Hongshuai Wang, Fujie Tang, Zhifeng Gao, Linfeng Zhang, Weinan E, Zhong-Qun Tian, Jun Cheng
arxiv-2408-15681.description: Abstract The study of structure-spectrum relationships is essential for spectral interpretation, impacting structural elucidation and material design. Predicting spectra from molecular structures is challenging due to their complex relationships. Herein, we introduce NMRNet, a deep learning framework using the SE(3) Transformer for atomic environment modeling, following a pre-training and fine-tuning paradigm.

arxiv-2506-22895.title: Interpretable Time Series Autoregression for Periodicity Quantification
arxiv-2506-22895.creator: Xinyu Chen, Vassilis Digalakis Jr, Lijun Ding, Dingyi Zhuang, and Jinhua Zhao
arxiv-2506-22895.description: Abstract Time series autoregression is a classical statistical model for capturing auto-correlations and identifying temporal patterns such as periodicity and seasonality. In this work, we propose a novel sparse autoregression framework from an interpretable machine learning perspective and the model interpretability for periodicity quantification is reinforced by ℓ 0 \ell_{0} -norm induced sparsity constraints.

arxiv-2510-14147.title: Distributed-Memory Parallel Algorithms for Fixed-Radius Near Neighbor Graph Construction
arxiv-2510-14147.creator: Gabriel Raulet 1 , Dmitriy Morozov 2 , Aydın Buluç 1 2 , Katherine Yelick 1
arxiv-2510-14147.description: Abstract Computing fixed-radius near-neighbor graphs is an important first step for many data analysis algorithms. Near-neighbor graphs connect points that are close under some metric, endowing point clouds with a combinatorial structure. As computing power and data acquisition methods advance, diverse sources of large scientific datasets would greatly benefit from scalable solutions to this common subroutine for downstream analysis.

pmc-10608595.title: Extracellular Vesicles of Porphyromonas gingivalis Disrupt Trophoblast Cell Interaction with Vascular and Immune Cells in an In Vitro Model of Early Placentation
pmc-10608595.creator: Brenda Lara, Matías Sassot, Guillermina Calo, Daniel Paparini, Laura Gliosca, Gabriela Chaufan, Iñaki Loureiro, Daiana Vota, Rosanna Ramhorst, Claudia Pérez Leirós, Vanesa Hauk, Juan Pablo Rigalli
pmc-10608595.description: Extracellular vesicles released by the primary pathogen of periodontal disease Porphyromonas gingivalis (Pg), referred to as outer membrane vesicles (OMVs), have been associated with the pathogenesis of systemic diseases like cardiovascular disease, rheumatoid arthritis, and Alzheimer’s disease. A pathogenic role for Pg by disrupting placental homeostasis was proposed in the association between periodontal disease and adverse pregnancy outcomes.

pmc-11285940.title: Serum susceptibility of Escherichia coli and its association with patient clinical outcomes
pmc-11285940.creator: Orianna Poteete, Phillip Cox, Felicia Ruffin, Granger Sutton, Lauren Brinkac, Thomas H. Clarke, Derrick E. Fouts, Vance G. Fowler, Joshua T. Thaden, Fiona J Radcliff, Fiona J Radcliff, Fiona J Radcliff
pmc-11285940.description: The innate immune system eliminates bloodstream pathogens such as Escherichia coli in part through complement protein deposition and subsequent bacterial death (i.e., “serum killing”). Some E. coli strains have developed mechanisms to resist serum killing, though the extent of variation in serum killing among bloodstream infection (BSI) isolates and the clinical impact of this variation is not well understood.

pmc-11447034.title: Machine learning analysis of a large set of homopolymers to predict glass transition temperatures
pmc-11447034.creator: Gerardo M Casanola-Martin, Anas Karuth, Hai Pham-The, Humbert González-Díaz, Dean C Webster, Bakhtiyor Rasulev
pmc-11447034.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Glass transition temperature of polymers, Tg, is an important thermophysical property, which sometimes can be difficult to measure experimentally. In this regard, data-driven machine learning approaches are important alternatives to assess Tg values, in a high-throughput way. In this study, a large dataset of more than 900 polymers with reported glass transition temperature (Tg) was assembled from various public sources in order to develop a predictive model depicting the structure-property relationships.

pmc-11465687.title: An international field study for the reliability and validity of the EORTC communication questionnaire EORTC QLQ-COMU26
pmc-11465687.creator: Juan Ignacio Arraras, Johannes Giesinger, Omar Shamieh, Iqbal Bahar, Michael Koller, Anne Bredart, Anna Costantini, Eva Greimel, Monika Sztankay, Lisa M. Wintner, Marina Carreiro de Sousa, Hiroto Ishiki, Meropi Kontogianni, Maja Wolan, Yuichiro Kikawa, Anne Lanceley, Ioannis Gioulbasanis, Amelie Har
pmc-11465687.description: BackgroundThe EORTC Quality of Life Group has developed a questionnaire to evaluate cancer patients’ perception of their communication with healthcare professionals (HCPs): the EORTC QLQ-COMU26. In this study we test the validity and reliability of this novel measure in an international and culturally diverse sample of cancer patients.

pmc-12506363.title: Perceived teacher support moderate the relationships between adverse childhood experiences and social adjustment among migrant children: a latent profile analysis
pmc-12506363.creator: Fang Wang, Xiaofeng Ma
pmc-12506363.description: BackgroundAdverse childhood experiences (ACEs) correlate with social adjustment. Notwithstanding the rising incidence of ACEs within migrant populations, there is a shortage of studies investigating ACEs patterns and the associated risk for social adjustment in migrant children.ObjectiveThe research seeks to examine the correlation between ACEs and social adjustment, and to investigate whether perceived teacher support moderates this relationship.

pmc-13065230.title: Donor-derived Cell-free DNA for Detection of Rejection After Pancreas Transplantation
pmc-13065230.creator: Abraham J. Matar, Samy Riad, Heidi Sarumi, Michael G. Megaly, Matthew Wright, Erik Finger, Vanessa Humphreville, Karthik Ramanathan, Jessica Fisher, Joseph S. Rao, Zachary Demko, Adam Prewett, Hossein Tabriziani, Raja Kandaswamy
pmc-13065230.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background.Donor-derived cell-free DNA (dd-cfDNA) has emerged as a promising noninvasive biomarker for detecting allograft rejection in solid organ transplantation. However, its diagnostic utility in pancreas transplantation, including in multiorgan recipients, remains underexplored.Methods.We conducted a retrospective analysis of 42 pancreas transplant recipients (38 simultaneous pancreas-kidney, 4 pancreas transplant alone) who underwent for-cause organ biopsy and dd-cfDNA testing between April 2020 and December 2024. dd-cfDNA was measured using the Prospera assay, with a threshold of ≥1% considered high risk and <1% low-risk.

pmc-13341336.title: Chronic Kidney Disease in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Cross‐Sectional Population‐Based Study
pmc-13341336.creator: Neora Alterman, Yoel Toledano, Noga Fallach, Victor Gross, Galia Zacay
pmc-13341336.description: AimsChronic kidney disease (CKD) is a common complication of Type 2 diabetes that frequently co‐occurs with cardiovascular disease. We aimed to characterise CKD in adults with Type 2 diabetes, quantify its prevalence across severity levels and examine pharmacological treatment patterns and healthcare utilisation.

pmc-13399108.title: MYB Factors: Hubs of Plant Stress and Hormone Crosstalk
pmc-13399108.creator: Aye Aye Htun, Ya Wang, Jiahao Liu, Zhiqiang Guo, Yi Zheng, Wenjie Wang, Shuting Ma, Aolin Jia, Yan Ren, Feng Chen
pmc-13399108.description: MYB transcription factors function as main regulatory hubs that integrate environmental signals with multi‐hormonal pathways to synchronize plant growth, metabolism and stress responses. This review delineates the regulatory roles of MYB in the signalling pathway of salicylic acid, jasmonic acid, ethylene and abscisic acid signalling.
